# Redgrass Creative

> Award-winning creative tools and lighting solutions for artists, miniature painters, and fine art creators.

Redgrass Creative specializes in innovative studio equipment including the iF Design Award-winning R9 Solo Desk Lamp and Everlasting Wet Palette systems. Their products feature advanced color-rendering technology (CRI, TM30-20) and are designed for professional and hobbyist painters working with acrylics, gouache, and miniatures.

## Key Topics

- Redgrass R9 Solo Desk Lamp
- Everlasting Wet Palette
- Studio XL ART
- LED lighting
- Color rendering (CRI, TM30-20)
- Miniature painting
- Wet palette hydration
- iF Design Award
- Acrylic painting
- Creative studio tools
- Painter Lite
- Fine art supplies
- Gouache painting
- Color Perfect technology
- Professional artist equipment

## Featured Products

- [Redgrass R9 Solo Desk Lamp](https://www.redgrasscreative.com/product/redgrass-r9-solo-desk-lamp): Award-winning LED lighting for creators with advanced color-rendering technology
- [Studio XL ART Wet Palette](https://www.redgrasscreative.com/product/studio-xl-art-wet-palette): Professional wet palette for fine art painting with advanced hydration system
- [Everlasting Wet Palette Painter Lite](https://www.redgrasscreative.com/product/wet-palette-painter-lite): Affordable miniature painting tool with everlasting hydration technology
